Commentary.Commentary: India made an excellent comeback with the ball in the middle overs. Kedar Jadhav and Ravindra Jadeja picked crucial wickets and stopped the run flow. Bhuvneshwar Kumar was good upfront and Jasprit Bumrah was on the money in the death overs. The Men in Blue would fancy themselves to chase this target down on a very good wicket. However, the Bangla Tigers will give it their all to build pressure on the famed Indian batting line-up. Join us for the chase in a while.

So, Bangladesh have crawled their way to a decent total, courtesy of their captain Mashrafe Mortaza who played a handy knock along with the tail towards the end. They recovered well after losing two early wickets. Tamim Iqbal and Mushfiqur Rahim were going great guns in the middle as they stitched a partnership of 123. However, after the departure of the southpaw, they lost their way as wickets kept on falling. Bangladesh would have liked to have 300 on the board but fell short.
On a length on off, Ahmed backs away and slaps it to wide mid off. A run taken. BANGLADESH FINISH ON 264/7.
Low full toss on off, Mortaza makes room and guides it straight to Ashwin at short third man. A run taken.
Back of a length delivery, Mortaza swings at it but gets a bottom edge. The ball bounces and hits him on the helmet.
Kumar is having a bit of issue with his ankle. He twisted his ankle while landing to bowl the delivery. He seems to be fine now.

Full and straight, Mortaza jams it through mid off for a single. Calls for the second as the throw at the non-striker's end is a poor one. Couple completed with ease. The replays show that Kumar did a bit of damage to his ankle in his followthrough.
Wide! Mortaza backs away and Kumar bowls it wide outside off. The Bangladesh skipper cannot reach it. Marginal call for wide.
Very full and tailing in, Mortaza looks to heave it to the leg side but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Bouncer on middle, Ahmed mistimes his pull over mid-wicket for a run. Importantly, brings Mortaza on strike.

Short delivery, following the batsman. Ahmed goes for the pull but gets a bit of glove on to his left shoulder. The ball rolls to short third man and the batsmen take a run. Maybe, he shouldn't have run and must have given the strike to his skipper.
Full toss on middle and leg, Mortaza slogs it to long on for a run.
The batsman has dug out that yorker at the last second.
Yorker around the boots, Mashrafe fails to jam it out.

FOUR! Hit with disdain! Back of a length on off, Mortaza backs away and slaps hard through the line. Yuvraj at mid off dives to his left but fails to stop it from going to the ropes. Three boundaries in a row.
FOUR! Streaky boundary! Short delivery, rising up on Mortaza. He goes for the pull but gets a top edge over Dhoni and the ball rolls to the fine leg fence. 250 up for Bangladesh.
FOUR! Fortune favours the brave! Low full toss on off, Ahmed swings hard at it but gets an outside edge past the keeper for a boundary.
Another short ball, Ahmed goes for the pull but only manages to connect thin air.
Bouncer on middle and leg, angling away. Ahmed goes for the hook but misses. Four precious dots in a row.
Play and a miss for the third time in a row! Length delivery, angling away. A tame push from Ahmed as he gets beaten again.
It's slower in pace this time outside off, Taskin pushes at it but gets beaten again. Good stuff from Kumar.
Length delivery, slanting away from Ahmed. He goes for a drive but misses.
On a length around off, Taskin looks to push at it but misses as the ball rolls to third man. A leg bye taken.
Low full toss on middle, Ahmed clips it to deep mid-wicket. A bit of a misfield from Yuvraj allows the batsmen to come back for the second. There was hesitation in the running but no harm done.
Bouncer in line of the stumps, Ahmed has to duck under it to evade it.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Shortish delivery on middle and leg, Mortaza goes for the pull but is hit on the forearm. That was sharp, must be hurting.

FOUR! Not a pretty shot but he gets the desired result! The skipper moves around the crease to unsettle Bumrah. However, the pacer bowls it fullish on off. Mortaza manages to get a thick inside edge which goes past Dhoni for a boundary.
Kumar goes for the yorker but ends up bowling a low full toss on middle. Mortaza turns it to mid-wicket for a run.
Short delivery outside off, slower one. Mashrafe goes for a cut but gets a bottom edge to the keeper.
FOUR! Streaky runs! Bouncer on middle, Mashrafe goes for the pull but gets a top edge and fortunately, it flies over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Shortish around off, tapped to short third man for a single.
Good length delivery, leaving the southpaw. Ahmed pushes at it but is beaten.
Fullish and tailing in on off, Mortaza pushes it back towards the bowler who leaps to take it but fumbles. A run taken.
Taskin Ahmed comes out to bat.

OUT! Timber! Mahmudullah makes room and Bumrah keeps it straight and full on off. The batsman looks to jam it out towards point but misses it completely to get his stumps rattled. India continue to chip away at the wickets.
Goes for the slower one but ends up bowling a low full toss down the leg side, Mahmudullah helps it towards fine leg. Kumar dives to his right and keeps the ball in play. Two runs taken.
Slower delivery on the pads, Mahmudullah is foxed by it as he is struck on the pads.
Mortaza makes room and Bumrah bowls it short towards his body. Mortaza drags it towards mid-wicket and sets off. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end.
Mashrafe moves around his crease and Bumrah bowls a full toss in line of the stumps. Flicked to mid-wicket.
Very full outside off, Mortaza looks to carve it behind point but misses.
Straying on the hips, worked to fine leg for a single.
Terrific yorker on middle and leg, a toe-crusher. Mashrafe somehow manages to keep it out as the ball rolls past the stumps.
FOUR! That was hit with authority! Dug in short around off, Mortaza nails the pull over mid-wicket for a rocketing boundary.
Fullish on middle and leg, Mortaza goes for a wild heave but is struck on the pads.
Back of a length, angling in. Turned round the corner for a single.
Shortish delivery outside off, Mahmudullah slaps it to Jadeja who dives to his left to make a great stop.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back on.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed to third man for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single. Mortaza is off the mark.
Sharp bouncer on off, Mortaza sways away from the line awkwardly. Brilliant way to welcome the Bangladesh skipper.
The skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza comes out to bat.

OUT! The short ball ploy works for Bumrah! India are on top now. He bowls a shortish delivery outside off as he sees Hossain using his feet. The young man still goes through with his pull shot although he is in an awkward position. Ends up getting it from the splice of the bat besides the pitch on the off side. Bumrah takes it safely in his followthrough. The defending champions are ecstatic.
Shortish outside off, Hossain cuts it to Jadeja who stops it to his left.
That's a peach! Gets it to straighten once again from a back of a length around off, Hossain is squared up as he looks to defend but misses.
Driven through mid on by the batsman.

Well bowled! Ashwin slips this down the leg side as he sees Mahmudullah take a couple of steps down the track. He misses as Dhoni collects it well and flicks the bails off but the batsman has his bat inside the crease.
Turning into Mahmudullah. He defends it to mid on.
Straying on the pads, nudged to short fine leg for a run.
Slow through the air on off, Mahmudullah looks to turn it to the leg side but gets a soft leading edge to the off side. A run taken.
FOUR! Nice improvisation! Tossed up on off, Mahmudullah goes for the fancy reverse sweep and connects well. Gets it over short third man for a boundary.
Well bowled! Back of a length ball around off, straightens after pitching. Hossain has a tame push at it but gets beaten all ends up.
Short of a length ball outside off, Hossain rises with the bounce and taps it to backward point.
FOUR! Shot! Fuller in length on middle, Hossain stays leg side of the ball and drills it through extra cover for a boundary.
Fuller in length and tailing in, clipped to mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery on middle and leg, Mahmudullah whips it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Good length delivery on middle, Mahmudullah turns it to the leg side.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Now a maximum of five fielders can be placed outside the circle. Bumrah is brought back into the attack.
Hossain defends it from within the crease. No run.
Wide! Down the leg side, Hossain looks to nudge it but misses.
Wide! Down the leg side, Hossain looks to nudge it but misses.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Two Leg byes! Hossain goes for the flick but misses. The ball brushes his pads and goes to fine leg. Yuvraj throws it to Dhoni who lets it go. An overthrow conceded.

FIVE PENALTY RUNS! Down the leg side, Mahmudullah paddles it down to fine leg. A run taken. Dhoni removes his gloves as he looks to collect the throw and deflect the ball back to the stumps at the striker's end but it bounces on his gloves near the wickets. Five penalty runs given by the umpire.
Flatter delivery outside off, Hossain dabs it to short third man for a single.
Tossed up on middle, driven to mid on.
Time for Drinks.
Lands it on a length outside off, Mahmudullah tries to push at it but gets beaten.
Short and outside off, Mahmudullah cuts it through point for a couple.
Short and outside off, Mahmudullah comes down the track and tries to heave it over mid-wicket but misses.

FOUR! DROPPED! Oh Ashwin, that should have been taken. Bowls it short outside off, Mahmudullah slashes at it and gets a thick outside edge, which flies down to third man. Ashwin makes good ground to his left and gets two hands to it but drops it. To add to it the ball rolls to the boundary. Kohli is not happy there.
Lands it on a length on off, Mahmudullah defends it off the front foot.
BEATEN! Bowls it outside off on a length, Mahmudullah pokes at it but gets beaten.
Hardik Pandya back into the attack.
Floats it on the stumps, Hossain flicks it on the leg side.
Bowls it on off, Mahmudullah drives it through mid on for a run.
Flighted on off, Hossain defends it on the off side for a quick run.
Slower on the pads, Hossain flicks it on the leg side.
Paddles it to short fine leg for a run.
Bowls it on the stumps, Mahmudullah tucks it towards square leg.
Ravichandran Ashwin is back into the attack.
FOUR! Shot! Short and width on offer. Hossain slaps it towards backward point. The fielder dives to his left but fails to stop it. The young man earns a boundary for himself.
Hossain waits for it and dabs it to short third man.
Quicker delivery outside off, played with an open face to point.
Loopy outside off, defended off the front foot on the off side.
Hossain looks to cut this one but the ball spins away to beat the outside edge.
Fullish outside off, drilled to sweeper cover for a run.
FOUR! Drags his length back outside off, Hossain cuts it through point for a boundary.

Plays it on the off side and Hossain sets off. Mahmudullah is halfway down the track but is sent back by Mosaddek. Dhoni throws it at the non-striker's end but it is a poor throw and Mahmudullah makes his ground.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Flatter ball on off, Jadhav defends it off the back foot.
Mosaddek Hossain comes out to bat.

OUT! Jadhav is making an impact with the ball. He tosses it up, Rahim comes down the track and takes it on the full and goes for a heave but hits it straight to Kohli at mid-wicket who takes a good low catch. Bangladesh have lost two in two overs. India have fought back into the game. A gutsy knock from Rahim comes to an end.
Very full ball, Rahim digs it out to covers.
Short outside off, Rahim cuts it through point for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Quicker on the stumps, Rahim defends it off the back foot.
Flatter ball outside off, Mahmudullah punches it through covers for a run.
Mahmudullah strides out to the middle.

OUT! JADEJA STRIKES! Shakib has to depart. The bowler drags his length back and bowls it outside off, turns in a touch, Shakib goes for the cut but gets it off the toe end of the bat to Dhoni who takes a good catch. Bangladesh have lost their way a bit. Jadeja is all pumped. He gets his first.
Flatter on the stumps, Hasan defends it off the back foot.
Punches it off the back foot to long on for a run.
Darts it in, Shakib punches it off the back foot to cover.
The batsman rocks onto the backfoot and punches the ball.
Quicker ball, Hasan slashes but gets an outside edge to short third man.
Tosses it up on middle, Shakib plays it on the front foot.
Flatter on the stumps, Rahim pushes it to long on for a run.
Bowled on the stumps, Shakib drives it back to the bowler.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Tossed it up on off, Shakib pushes it to long off for a run.
Tosses it up on off, Rahim pushes it through covers for a run.
Flatter outside off, Shakib cuts it through point for a run.
FOUR! POOR LINE! Short and wide outside off, Shakib cuts it behind point where the fielder dives and gets a hand to it but the ball races away to the fence.
Slower on the pads, Rahim works it to mid-wicket. He sets off for a run but is sent back by Shakib. Kohli picks the ball and throws it at the striker's end but Rahim is in.
Drags his length back on off, Shakib cuts it behind point. Jadeja dives to his right and makes a good stop. They run a single.
Doles it on the pads, Rahim flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Plays the sweep shot straight to square leg.
Flatter on off, Rahim pushes it to covers off the back foot.
Quicker through the air outside off, Shakib drives it to cover. Kohli misfields and concedes a run.
Fires it outside off, the ball turns into the batsman. Shakib guides it to short third man for a run.
Flatter on the stumps, Rahim mistimes his sweep to mid-wicket for a run.
Arm ball on the stumps, Rahim defends it off the front foot.
Doles it on middle, the southpaw guides it down to short fine leg for a run.
Bowls it on the stumps, Shakib drives it back to the bowler.
Flatter on off, Shakib plays it to point.
Short and room on offer, cut to deep point for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Drifting into Shakib. He works it to square leg for a single.
Flatter ball on leg, nudged to square leg for a run.
Fullish this time, stroked to mid on for a single.
Floated outside off, pushed to the covers.
Fullish delivery, defended off the front foot to point.
Quicker one on the pads, turned to square leg for a single.
Tossed up ball, pushed back to the bowler.
Leg slip in place now.
Rahim works this to the leg side for a single.
Quicker one outside off, turned to mid-wicket.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Shakib Al Hasan strides out to bat. He scored a ton in the last game, can he repeat his heroics in this match too?

OUT! Bowled 'em! Lands it on a length around off, coming in with the arm. Iqbal kneels, goes for the slog sweep but misses it completely to see the furniture behind him shattered. He was early into the shot and pays the price for it. Pressure was building and it has resulted in a wicket. A good knock from Iqbal comes to an end. Important breakthrough for India. The 123-run stand from 127 balls is finally broken.
Fullish delivery, eased to mid off.
Tossed up outside off, Iqbal drags his heave to the mid-wicket fielder.
Shortish outside off, Rahim cuts it towards Kumar at cover-point. He runs to his right, dives and parries it towards extra cover. A single taken.
Wide! Slips this one down the leg side, Rahim misses his tuck.
Tossed up delivery, pushed back to the bowler.
Slow through the air on leg stump, Rahim looks to flick it but gets a soft leading edge to the right side of Jadhav.
Landed outside off, dabbed to point for a run.
Straying on the pads, nudged to the leg side for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Iqbal works it with the spin to mid-wicket.
26th ODI fifty for Rahim.

Fullish delivery outside off, Rahim goes for a drive but gets an inside edge to fine leg. A run taken. A well-deserved half century for the wicket-keeper batsman. He has rotated the strike nicely and has took toll of the loose deliveries.
Leg bye! Darted in towards the pads, Iqbal misses his flick as the ball brushes his pads and rolls to short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Tossed up delivery, Iqbal plays it to point for a run.
Flatter on middle, turned to short fine leg for a single.
Low full toss outside off, eased to long off for a run.
Straying on the pads, worked to the leg side for a single.
A bit short outside off again, Iqbal cuts it to sweeper cover for a run.
Shortish in line of the stumps, Rahim pulls it through square leg. Ashwin in the deep goes to his left and slides to keep it down to a single.
Kedar Jadhav to have a bowl now.
Quicker one on middle, Mushfiqur punches it to long on for a run.
Flatter in line of the stumps, pushed back to the bowler.
Short on middle and leg, pulled hard to deep square leg for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Flat on middle, turned to mid-wicket. There is a direct hit at the striker's end but no harm done.
Rahim taps it to covers. Iqbal wants the run and takes off. Dhawan gets across to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. No one is backing up. An extra run taken.
Landed on middle, punched to long on for a single. 7 from the over, single from every ball at least. Good batting from the duo.
Loopy ball outside off, stroked to sweeper cover for a single.
Rahim is nimble on his feet and strokes it with the spin to long on for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Rahim kneels and slog sweeps it uppishly to deep mid-wicket for a run.
100-run stand up between Rahim and Iqbal.
Floated on off, Rahim shuffles across and paddle scoops it over the keeper's head. Yuvraj runs across to his right from fine leg and keeps it down to two.
Fullish delivery, worked to mid-wicket for a run.
Short and room on offer, Rahim cuts it to deep point for a couple.
Close to the off stump, dabbed neatly to short third man for a single.
Flatter on middle, turned to mid-wicket.
Short outside off, cut through point for a single.
Quicker one on leg, Rahim  whips it over mid-wicket. Kumar hares to his left and slides to keep the ball in play. Keeps it down to two.
FOUR! Make it three in a row! Straying on the pads, a loose ball and Iqbal tickles it through fine leg to find the fence.
FOUR! Iqbal anticipates that this one will be bowled closer to him and backs away. Uses his feet and chips it over the infield on the off side for another boundary.
FOUR! Well played! Ashwin comes around the wicket and tosses it up around off, Iqbal drives it through square of the wicket on the off side to earn a boundary.
Low full toss outside off, Mushfiqur strokes it to deepish mid off for a run.
Rahim uses his feet to this one and plays it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Floated outside off, played with an open face to short third man.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Short outside off, cut to backward point for a single.
Stays back to the flatter delivery and pushes it to the right side of the bowler.

Not out! Rahim survives a close call. Floated around off, spinning away. Rahim attempts the slog sweep but misses. Dhoni takes the bails off in a flash and appeals. It is referred upstairs. The replays show that Rahim had his back foot out of the crease for a moment but got back just in time.
There is a stumping appeal against Rahim.
Tossed up delivery, eased to the off side.
FOUR! Nice improvisation! Tossed up on middle and leg, Rahim premeditates and executes his reverse sweep well. Gets it over the backward point fielder for a boundary.
Flighted ball on off, Rahim makes a little room and guides it down to short third man for a run. Just one off the over.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.
Doles it on the stumps, Rahim plays it with the turn to square leg.
Rahim comes down the track and defends it off the front foot.
Full ball, Rahim drives it to mid on.
Tosses it up, Rahim tries to defend it but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
38th ODI fifty for Tamim Iqbal.

FOUR! Just over backward point. Bowls it on off, Tamim goes for a reverse sweep but gets a top edge which goes just over Bumrah at backward point for a boundary. Brings his 50, a very good knock by Tamim. He has had his luck but you can take nothing away from his innings. He is now also the leading run-scorer of this year's Champions Trophy.
Tosses it up, Rahim drives it through covers for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter on the stumps, Rahim defends it off the back foot.
Bowls it fuller on the stumps, Iqbal drives it down to long on for a run.
Quicker through the air on the stumps, Iqbal plays it through square leg for a couple.
It is looking dark at one side of the ground. Grey clouds are building up. Let's hope the rain stays away. Meanwhile, Ravindra Jadeja to roll his arm over now.
Tosses it up on off, Iqbal drives it to long off for a run.
Rahim gets down the track and pushes it to long on for a run.
Drags his length back outside off, Rahim cuts it behind point for a couple.
Bowls it on the stumps, Iqbal punches it to long on for a run.
Doles it on off, Tamim plays it off the back foot.
Tosses it on middle, Rahim tucks it through square leg for a run.
Time for Drinks.
Doles it on a length outside off, Rahim guides it down to third man for a run.
Shorter in length on the stumps, Rahim ducks under it.
Length outside off, Iqbal guides it down to third man for a run.
SIX! BANG! That is going, going and gone. Tamim comes down the track and just picks it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. That was a brilliant pick up shot.
On the pads, Rahim flicks it thorugh the leg side for a run.
50-run stand between Tamim Iqbal and Mushfiqur Rahim.
Short again, Iqbal pulls it through square leg for a run. It has been a very good partnership for Bangladesh.
On the pads, Tamim sweeps it through square leg for a run.
FOUR! DEFT TOUCH! Bowls it outside off, Tamim just guides it past the short third man fielder for a boundary. These two are ticking along well here.
Tosses it up, Rahim goes down on one knee and paddle sweeps it through fine leg for a run.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads. They pick up a single.
Drags his length back, Rahim punches it off the back foot to long on for a run.
Flights it on off, Iqbal drives it to long off for a run.
Hurls it on middle, Tamim flicks it through square leg for a run.
WIDE! Shorter in length, but it is signaled a wide for height.
Doles it on the stumps, Rahim tucks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Short and wide outside off, Rahim goes for the cut but gets beaten. Dhoni does not collect it cleanly behind the stumps.
Bowls it on the pads, Tamim flicks it on the leg side for a run.
BOUNCER! Tamim comes down the track but does not play a shot.
Bowls it on a length, Tamim plays it to the point region.
Iqbal stays leg side of the ball, uses his feet and strokes it to long off for a run.
Loopy delivery around off, Rahim sweeps it through square leg. Jadeja comes running in from fine leg but the batsmen decide to run only one. There was a couple on offer.
A touch short outside off, Rahim cuts to backward point.
Fullish delivery, eased to long off for a single.
Floated in line of the stumps, Tamim keeps it out.
Tossed up delivery on middle, defended off the front foot.
Wide! Going down the leg side, Iqbal looks to flick but misses.
Short again on the body of the batsman, Tamim pulls it down to fine leg for a run.
FOUR! He does make full use of this one. Pandya bowls a full toss and Iqbal smashes it straight back past the bowler for a boundary.
WIDE! Bowls it full outside off, umpire calls it a wide.
Drama as Iqbal gets bowled but it won't be counted. Pandya has overstepped and what a time to do it. To add salt to the wound, Free Hit is coming up...

BOWLED OFF A NO BALL! Tamim survives and Hardik cannot believe it. He doles it on a length outside off, Tamim goes for the pull but gets an inside edge onto the stumps and the umpire calls a no ball. Second one of the over. Tamim would want to make full use of this free hit.
The batsman guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Hurls it on a length outside off, Tamim guides it down to third man for a run.

Bangs it short again, outside off this time. Tamim makes room and tries to flat bat it but hits it straight up in the air to point. Kumar at point takes the catch and throws it to Dhoni who whips the bails and appeals but the umpire does not give it out. They run two.
Free Hit Time.
NO BALL! Out of a no ball. Bowls a short ball on the stumps, Tamim goes to pull it but gets a top edge which just clears mid-wicket and they run two. An extra fielder was outside the circle.
Lands it on a length from around the wicket, Tamim plays it off the front foot.
Hardik Pandya is brought into the attack.
Bowls it on the pads, Rahim tucks it on the leg side. Just 2 off the over.
Flights it on off, Rahim defends it off the front foot.
Quicker on off, Tamim guides it down to third man for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
WIDE! Floats it down the leg side, Tamim goes for a flick but misses. Umpire calls a wide.
Bowls it on middle, Tamim defends it on the off side. He wants a run but is sent back. Kohli was quick to the ball and made sure the run was not taken.
Tosses it up on leg, Tamim drives it back to the bowler.
Ravichandran Ashwin comes into the attack. A slip in place for him.
Bowls a well-directed bouncer, Rahim ducks under it. End of a good over by Kumar.
Back of  a length angling into the batsman, Rahim defends it off the back foot.
Hurls it on a length, angling away, Tamim guides it down to third man for a run.
Good length ball on middle, Iqbal pushes it to mid on.
Doles it on the leg stump, Tamim looks to flick but gets a leading edge to the off side.
Lands it on a length outside off, Tamim comes down the track and tries to hit it over off side but misses.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. A maximum of four fielders can be placed outside the circle till the 40th over.
On a length, Rahim covers the line and blocks it. Another tidy over, only a run from it.
Full length delivery on off, Rahim eases it to mid on.
Fullish in line of the stumps, turned round the corner for a run.
Short of a length, shaping in. Iqbal rises up on his toes and looks to work it across but again gets it off the leading edge down the track.
Fullish and angling in, Iqbal uses his feet a bit and looks to turn it across but is early into his stroke. Gets a safe leading edge down the track.
Stays back to the short of the length delivery and dabs it to point.
FOUR! Make it three in a row! Shortish and room on offer, Rahim slaps it through point to find the fence once again. Shot of the day so far says Ganguly on air. 13 from the over.
FOUR! Exquisite! Fuller length ball outside off, Rahim creams it through extra cover for a gorgeous boundary.

FOUR! Streaky boundary! That was a close shave as well. Back of a length delivery outside off, Rahim uses his feet and looks to force it through the off side but gets a thick inside edge which goes past the stumps, beats the keeper and rolls to the fine leg fence.
Kumar comes over the wicket and bowls it fullish around the pads, Iqbal looks to turn it through square leg but gets an inside edge to fine leg. A run taken.
Fullish and shaping in, Tamim works it to mid-wicket.
Fuller length ball outside off, shaping in. Iqbal looks to defend with minimal foot movement but gets a bit of an outside edge towards the slip cordon.
Well bowled! In the corridor of uncertainty, Rahim feels for it but gets beaten all ends up. Good seam position when it was delivered and Mushfiqur didn't have any clue about it.
Fuller length ball outside off, Rahim drives it crisply to covers. Jadhav dives to his left and saves certain runs for his side. Good effort.
Stays back to the length delivery and defends it.
Back of a length in line of the stumps, Rahim hops back and defends it.
Fullish delivery, driven to mid off.
Fuller length  ball around off, Iqbal prods forward to defend but gets it off the outer half past the slip region. A run taken.
Fuller around off, Rahim presses forward and defends it to covers. Wicket maiden for Kumar.
Mushfiqur Rahim comes out to bat.

OUT! A shot too many from Rahman! Shortish delivery and width on offer, Sabbir looks to cash in on the width. Slaps it uppishly towards Jadeja at backward point but doesn't bother to keep it down. It goes straight to the best fielder of the Indian side and he makes no mistake. Kumar is pumped up and so is Virat Kohli! Rahman's entertaining knock comes to an end. The replays show that it was a knuckle ball.
Dug in short this time, Sabbir ducks under it.
Slower delivery this time, Rahman comes forward and defends.
Fuller length ball outside off, played with an open face to point.
Rahman gives the charge and Kumar bangs it in short. Left alone.
Iqbal stays back to the length delivery and defends it to covers. A maiden bowled by Bumrah.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
That's a peach! Back of a length delivery around off, straightens after pitching. Iqbal pokes at it but gets beaten. He was very tentative to that.
Straight again, worked to the leg side.
On a length and angling into the southpaw. Iqbal turns it to square leg.
Fullish delivery around off, Iqbal pats it to mid off.
Rahman comes down the track and Kumar bangs it in short. Still, Sabbir goes through with his shot but misses.
Dug in short on middle, Sabbir ducks under the sharp bumper.
Back of a length on off, Rahman covers the line and defends it.

Iqbal taps this fullish delivery to mid-wicket and sets off. Jadhav comes across and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. The replays show that even if it hit, Tamim was in. Kohli is a bit angry, he feels that Kedar should have done better.
FOUR! Streaky runs! On a length on the pads, Iqbal looks to nudge it early and ends up getting a leading edge past the slip region. Another boundary results.
Good length around the pads, Iqbal fails to tuck it and is struck on the pads.
Back of a length on off, defended solidly off the back foot.

FOUR! The aggressive ploy is working for Rahman at the moment. Comes down the track to the fuller length ball on off and hits it over Kohli at mid off for a boundary. The bat turned a bit in his hands but he managed to get enough on it.
Similar length ball around off, Rahman keeps it out to covers.
Short of a length on off, Sabbir stays back and defends it.
Ball hits the batsman low on the pads. They pick up a single. Leg byes given by the umpire.
Beaten! Length delivery outside off, leaving the southpaw. Iqbal feels for it but misses.
FOUR! Shot! Fuller length ball outside off, Rahman strokes it through cover-point and gets the desired result. Good positive start from Rahman.
Good length delivery around off, angling in. Rahman hops back and looks to tuck it but is hit on the thigh pad. A stifled appeal for an LBW is turned down. Height was always a factor.
Full and outside off, Sabbir goes for a drive but gets an inside edge through backward square leg. Two runs taken.
FOUR! Intent from Rahman! On a length outside off, Rahman charges down the track and lifts it over wide mid off for a boundary.
On a length and outside off, played with an open face to point.
A bit of drizzle is in the air.
Length delivery around off, shaping in. Sabbir covers the line and defends it.
In the channel outside off, Iqbal plays inside the line and lets it go. Good end to the over after being hit for two boundaries.
Back of a length outside off, Sabbir slashes at it but gets an outside edge to third man. A run taken.
Cuts him into two halves! Good length delivery outside off, shapes in appreciably. Rahman looks to block it but the ball whizzes through the gap between his bat and pad.
FOUR! Beautifully played! Length ball outside off, Rahman drives it elegantly through cover-point and the ball whistles away to the fence.
Straighter on this occasion, Iqbal turns it to the leg side for a run.
Four leg byes! Straying on the hips, Iqbal turns it through fine leg. Kumar runs to his left, puts in a dive but fails to stop the boundary. However, the umpire signals it as four leg byes.
Sabbir Rahman is the new man in.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl with the second new ball.

OUT! Kumar gets the better of Soumya Sarkar! Lures him into a false stroke and he perishes. Just the start India needed. Bowls a length delivery around off, angling away. Sarkar goes for a booming drive but only manages to get a thick inside edge that crashes into the stumps. Played away from the body and paid the price for it. Intelligent bowling has done the trick.
Good length delivery on off, seaming away after hitting the deck. Sarkar points his bat skywards to let it go.
On a length on leg stump, Tamim hops back and turns it to square leg for a run. Bangladesh are away.
Straight on this ocassion, on middle and leg, Iqbal defends it down the track.
Almost a replica of the previous delivery as Tamim doesn't fiddle with that one.
Starts off with a fuller length delivery outside off, shaping away. Iqbal plants his front foot forward and lets it go.

We have some good news coming your way. The players are coming out for their respective National Anthems as the drizzle has gone away. After the completion, we are ready to get underway. Tamim Iqbal and Soumya Sarkar to open the batting for Bangladesh. India to begin the proceedings with Bhuvneshwar Kumar. Two slips in place. Here we go...
1020 local time update - Drizzle is in the air and the covers are on. Let's hope it is a passing shower and the weather clears out.
PITCH REPORT - Michael Slater doing the pitch report says that the wicket is a fresh one. Adds that it looks a bit dry but will play well. Mentions that it will be good for strokeplay.

Bangladesh skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza says they would have also bowled first. Admits they have to play with confidence. Further adds that they don't want to look too much into the fact that they have beaten India before. Opines they have improved a lot in the last two years and they want to go further. He feels there is a lot of expectations from the team and informs they are playing with an unchanged side.

India skipper, Virat Kohli says that they are going to have a bowl. Adds that it is a fresh wicket. Mentions that the conditions are overcast and we might have an on and off time in the field. Reckons that no side are the favourites. Further adds that they have been surprised in the league stages once. States that Bangladesh are a good side and they can't afford to take them lightly. Ends by saying that they are playing with an unchanged team.
Toss - India win the toss and opt to field.

Bangladesh are playing their first semifinal in an ICC tournament. This itself should boost their confidence. Mashrafe Mortaza would want every player to bring their A game to the fore today to beat the favorites, India. Can the Bangla Tigers spring in a surprise or will the Men in Blue prove to be too strong for them? Let us wait and watch.

Welcome to Edgbaston for the second semifinal of the 2017 ICC Champions Trophy. India will battle it out against Bangladesh for a spot in the final. Their batting is in sublime form and Virat Kohli would hope it continues that way. Their bowlers also proved their potential after having a bad day at the office against Sri Lanka. The Men in Blue are looking ominous and will look to continue the momentum.
